segments.text: Some patrons will ask
Do you offer sexual services?
Massage or sexual services?
Some TCM licenses
have been used for illicit businesses
Misuse of license for illicit business
People will break laws for profit
but they won’t run a business at a loss
Who is the one profiting?
Who owns the business?
Nobody ever knows
Who is the real boss?
For every measure, there is a countermeasure
Absolutely
They’re not just smart, they’re exceptionally smart
Happy ending massage parlours
have spread from Geylang to HDB estates
sparking discontent among residents
and affecting the community
From the second half of the year
all massage parlours must be licensed
And display notices to make reporting to the Police easier
But do these new measures address the root cause?
Is the Government fixing the problem
or playing catch up?
Today, we have with us Dickson Mah
Wong Kee Soon
Heng Buck Teck
When we talk about massage parlours in the past
we always think of Geylang
But recently, massage parlours have been popping up
in HDB estates and even void decks
The Police are conducting frequent raids
in places like Boon Lay and Jurong West
and really cracking down on such businesses
Dickson, do you face any pressure
or misunderstanding from the residents?
Some patrons will ask
Do you offer sexual services?
Many of my colleagues tell me
when they eat at neighbourhood coffeeshops
people look at them and wonder
if they offer sexual services
Some of them can’t tell
which shop is legitimate and which isn’t
So, we’re all the same to them
They think of “spas” negatively
If they’re wearing the same uniform
black tops and black pants
Or if they look slightly prettier
they’ll get mistaken for a sex worker
Beyond legitimate massage parlours
TCM practitioners have also been affected
Some TCM licenses
have been used for illicit businesses
Some of my fellow TCM practitioners
as well as myself have experienced this
Sometimes, we’ll get a customer
who questions if we’re qualified TCM practitioners
Some would ask if we offer massage services
We find this puzzling
because this is a TCM clinic
Why would a patient ask about massages?
It creates unnecessary problems
Maybe the regulations were looser back then
As long as you have a TCM license
you can run a Category 3 massage establishment (ME)
That’s all you need
-Open-concept  -Yes
But the authorities have now stepped in
Our ethical code and guidelines don’t allow this
But driven by profit
the earnings can also be quite high
Or it may be due to personal health reasons
When they grow older and lose their income
some get exploited by others
Their licenses are misused to open so-called “clinic”
You mentioned the money. How much are they paid?
It depends on the agreement
Some don’t ask for a lot
Some just want a few thousand dollars
There is no fixed market rate
These shops existed in HDB estates 20 years ago
But they have a proper shopfront
Operating differently on the surface and behind the scenes
They might be running a minimart outside
and offering sexual services in the back or upstairs
There would be a lookout downstairs
What we call a “watchman”
Why are more of them appearing in HDB estates over time?
It’s simple logic
A pigeon starts eating scraps outside an eatery
If nobody chases it away
it'll slowly make its way inside and start eating there
The situation wasn’t being regulated tightly
And with HDB estates
the patrons are staying residents there
They don’t need to travel far
They can just pop downstairs, check if anyone’s looking
before walking in
They can go to a minimart
or a hair salon
Pass the hair salon
and either go to the back or upstairs
A lot of uncles hanging around at coffeeshops
earn fees from referrals
They meet their friends at the coffeeshop
And when their friends express interest
they ask if they want to know where to go
They solicit customers at coffeeshops
It’s a common practice
They get something out of it too
They’re both nodding
You agree with what he’s said
From a business perspective
If I charge a patron $100
and get 10 patrons a day, I’ll earn $1,000
If I have five rooms
I can earn $5,000 a day
In 30 days, that’s $150,000
You can earn $150,000 a month
At almost no cost
excluding basic rental and manpower
That’s amazing profit margin for a business
because the costs are so low
-You have outlets in HDB estates  -Yes
You have outlets in the CBD
and in the fancier parts of the city too
Are the outlets in HDB estates different?
Big shopping malls are owned by
real estate investment trusts
You can’t run such businesses there
The mall management also screens their tenants
In HDB estates, individuals
that is, retail investors, lease the space
It’s down to willing buyers and willing sellers
The barrier to entry is lower
Basically
landlords only care about their returns
So, it’s easier to set up shop in HDB estates
Is the rental cheaper?
It depends
Because they’re willing to pay more
the landlord sees this as a good deal and accepts it
Some say the Police have been conducting raids
and the media has been reporting
but such activities haven’t stopped
Sometimes, if you don’t work with the public or community
you end up treating the symptoms, not the disease
It’s like acupuncture. Hitting the wrong spot won’t work
Regardless the agency in charge
they need to have a down-to-earth discussion
leverage the power of the people
to explore the issue extensively
It prevents hasty generalisations
From another perspective
for example, Buck Teck told us
about customers who ask about massages
he finds that offensive
because his clinic is a legitimate business
But put yourself in my shoes
I may be asking because my neck aches
So, I want to know if you offer massages
That’s how I interpret
The lack of communication and understanding
results in a lot of misunderstanding
What exactly is keeping this industry alive?
People will break laws for profits
but they won’t run a business at a loss
Because there’s money to be made
Those involved in illegal activities
don’t know anything
They give straight in
For example
near my shop in Geylang, there’s a street
Just walk down that street without looking
there’s one every few shops
Nobody ever knows who owns the business
If the police conduct a raid
they end up arresting a Tua Pek Kong
But you’ll never run out of Tua Pek Kong
What is a Tua Pek Kong?
The fall guy / The scapegoat
The name on the license
That person might be a retiree
If nothing happens
they get paid $1,500, $2,000 monthly
If something does, they take the fall
They still get paid after they are jailed
They pay compensation to the family
Yes, but imagine if the penalty is severe
If you get 10 years in prison, people will stop
The problem is the penalties are too light
You’re released after a few weeks
Our prison is also the world’s most comfortable
I know because I used to be a volunteer counsellor
and taught bread making classes in prison
Are the TCM practitioners who do this
also called Tua Pek Kong?
No, they’re not exactly the same
They’re not Tua Pek Kong
They’re just TCM practitioners
Some are trying to make a living, some are exploited
Some get approached by others who tell them
You’re old and retired and have no income
Let me use your license to open a clinic
Some are ignorant, others pretend they don’t know
Some know but want to try their luck
Maybe few people get caught
and the fines aren’t that heavy anyway
That’s what is going on
My friend here is a good man
I’m not as good as he is
Unlike him, who’s focused on helping others
I’m the curious sort
I like to dig into every profession and industry
This is what I know about the TCM industry
If a TCM practitioner has few customers
or is retired
the illegal operator will offer
the shopfront for your clinic
You don’t have to pay rent
I’ll run my business in the back
When the customers step inside
at least there’s a first barrier
a lookout out front
If they think something’s wrong
they can press a button to alert the rest
You probably know what happens next
The illegal operator rents the space
and gets the TCM practitioner to move in
That’s usually what happens
They hurt our industry’s image
It’s not really fair to the legitimate businesses
How much higher are your costs?
When applying for a license
we also need to apply for CaseTrust accreditation
The highest tier
Why? To meet their requirements
CaseTrust’s requirements are very stringent
We work hard to meet them
The police have stringent ME license requirements
For example, on uniforms and name tags
Even customers
You need to register all the details
Your rooms must stay unlocked
Even when our clientele is mostly women
we still applied for the license
because we want to build the business and industry
To become a TCM practitioner
you must spend five to seven years studying
and pass an exam to get your license
Every two years, you must attend
Continuing Professional Education classes
and get 50 points to renew your license
You have to pay for all these classes
You only get 1 point for an hour of class
You still have to rent a place for your clinic
pay for your herbs, needles and equipment
When people like that are in our industry
we get badly affected
Some claim they offer TCM treatments and tui na
If something bad happens and gets in the news
the public won’t know the details
They’ll pin the blame on TCM practitioners again
So, this really hurts our image
To run a licensed massage parlour
you don’t need to be a qualified professional
The barrier to entry is lower
Anyone can do it
As long as you are a businessman
you can get a license
Of course, you have to be a director
But if anything happens
like we said earlier
the Tua Pek Kong will take the fall
But it’s easier to find a Tua Pek Kong
because they don’t need any qualifications
From our perspective
we’re a business that focuses on wellness through massage
and on our customers’ health
We want our therapists, massage
and tui na therapists
to become respected professions
Are we not able to identify the offenders hiring the Tua Pek Kong?
We didn’t try because that’s not our job
Do you have any suggestions?
Anything we can do better?
The posters for reporting at the shopfront?
To put bluntly
Only someone in the same line will file a report
But to get a bystander to do that
you'll need to offer a reward
Nobody’s going to do this for free
Nobody’s going to do it
It’s not really going to work
Firstly, it’s not going to work
Secondly
if the whistleblower has to provide their details
they'll worry their identity might get leaked
Do you have such worries?
If you haven’t done anything wrong
you don’t have to worry
The police need evidence to charge someone
So, I understand why they need
the whistleblower’s details
Without evidence, you can’t take legal action
and charge the person
I remember when officials audited our place
Someone reported that we had condoms in our shop
and he’s here to find them
But why would we have condoms?
We don’t offer such services
Why would we keep stuff like that around?
I had a similar experience
The police came to my clinic
I guess it’s because I have two young assistants
Some uncles would ask us if we offer certain services
Right across the street, there’s a massage parlour
with many pretty employees
Most of them are foreigners
The police would raid the place frequently
One time, two officers came over
They said, we’re cops. I wondered what’s up
They wanted me to show them my TCM certificate
I asked why. They said it’s nothing serious.
Someone made a report
They looked around, then left
They saw that we’re offering legitimate acupuncture services
I think the raids really help regulate
I support them
If we’ve done nothing wrong
There’s nothing to worry
I think it’s a waste of resources
When they went after the streetwalkers in Geylang
two things happened
Where did the streetwalkers go?
Did they go home? No
They found themselves an uncle
who got them a room in a budget hotel for a month
drove them around
became their pimp and took a cut
Nothing really changed
except you have smaller moving pieces
My biggest concern
is if the industry isn’t licensed
and the sex workers don’t go for checkups
I may be strolling downstairs
and end up engaging their services
But she’s not seen a doctor
so, I end up contracting HIV
When I go home
I transmit it to my wife or to the family
I think the police should pause their raids
Issue a notice to these businesses
If they’re legitimate, they should set up an association
Get advisors from different walks of life
Hold regular meetings
and communicate to the government
Give them concrete suggestions
The illegal businesses won’t join the association
since members can conduct inspections
If I am an advisor for the association
I can audit its member companies any time
without prior notice
I can visit his clinic
We have many associations
for TCM practitioners, massage therapists and so on
Who’s going to lead this?
A Member of Parliament
or someone like that can oversee this
This is for the good of the entire nation
How can the public tell which business is legitimate?
We can have some kind of certification
If a business is legitimate
it gets issued a certificate to be posted at its shopfront
That’s the best. If a shop doesn’t have that
the customer knows what they’re getting into
It’s easier for the public to tell the two apart
The authorities don’t have to work so hard
to attend to every complaint immediately
only to end up at a legitimate business
and waste their time
I think that’ll be more effective
We don’t have such certification now
But some shops are more obvious
Their lighting is dimmer
They have LED lights
They use dark wallpaper
That’s quite obvious
Those are easy to identify
I also hope the media can report on
the legitimate businesses
so that the public knows what we’re doing
Hopefully, that can improve our industry’s image
I’m also hoping
only allow licensed TCM practitioners
to use the term “TCM” for their business
I hope the TCM Practitioner Board can play a bigger role
When there is negative publicity in the news
I hope the board can step up and defend us
But no matter how tight the regulations
there are always loopholes
They’ll have a way
For every measure, there is a countermeasure
Of course, especially for these operators
They’re not just smart, they’re exceptionally smart
The government has tightened regulations
and the public has made their voices heard
Will that be enough to fix this problem?
We’ll have to wait and see
A good community cannot be achieved
unless everyone works together to protect it
Can we really stamp out happy ending massage parlours?
Tell us what you think below
Thank you for your time
